goal: Target-Conditioned Candidate Localization and End-to-End MOT Improvement
central_question: Given that InterMOT can learn a useful cross-scene identity representation but remains limited by P1 candidate localization quality, can target-conditioned candidate localization/refinement plus controlled identity-aware association convert that subsystem capability into measurable end-to-end MOT gains in HOTA and AssA without materially damaging DetA?
